neighbours.label: naming kinds or classes of a thing ('some kinds of bulbs', 'muscle cells', 'all controlled by')
fire: There is a spot in every yard for some kinds of roses.
The body has nerve cells that signal and muscle cells that contract.
In three weeks the stem cells turn into muscle tissue.
Bones, joints and muscles are all controlled by the brain.
Some types of bacteria live in the gut without harm.
The forest holds many kinds of birds and several groups of bats.
Different types of cells perform different jobs in the liver.
Some kinds of fungi grow only on dead wood.
quiet: There is a shed in every yard behind the roses.
The body was found near the bridge by two boys.
In three weeks the family moves into a new home.
Bread, jam and milk are on the kitchen table.
Some bread was left on the table without a cover.
The forest was quiet and the path was dark by noon.
Different people live in different houses on the street.
Some milk spilled on the floor of the old shop.
